verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service. A product like this could plausibly offer developer SDKs, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack has no mention of any SDK, API or developer tooling. Customer management is documented only through the consumer app and online dashboard, and probes for OpenAPI specs at all candidate paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
